in_arabic.name: ريحان
in_arabic.meaning: نبتة طيبة الرائحة، زهرة، عطر، نبات ذو رائحة طيبة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه نبتة طيبة الرائحة، زهرة، عطر، نبات ذو رائحة طيبة. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة يس: 'وَلِتُخْرِجَ النَّبَاتَ كُلَّهُ فَمَآ أَنَاْ بِمُخْرِجٍ مِّنَ الأَرْضِ حَتَىٰ يَقُولَ الرَّسُولُ وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا مَعَهُ مَتَىٰ نُصْرُ اللَّهِ أَلَا إِنَّ نَصْرَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ' الآية 78، و ريحانة: اسم مؤنث معناه النبت الطيب الرائحة.

in_urdu.name: ریحان
in_urdu.meaning: ایک خوبصورت خوشبو دار پودا، خوشبو، عطر
in_urdu.long_meaning: ریحان علم کا ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے. اس کا مطلب ایک خوبصورت خوشبو دار پودا، خوشبو، عطر سے ہے. یہ نام قرآن مجید میں سورة يس میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے. مسلم دنیا میں اس نام کا استعمال ایک خوبصورت اور معطر پودے کی طرح خوشبودار زندگی گزارنے کے لیے کیا جاتا ہے.

in_english.name: Raihaan
in_english.long_meaning: Raihaan is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning fragrant plant, scented flower, or perfume. It is mentioned in the Quran, Surah Yasin. The name Raihaan symbolizes a person who brings joy, peace, and pleasantness to others, much like the fragrance of a plant. In Islamic tradition, Raihaan is considered a blessed name, signifying a person with a pleasant character and demeanor. The name is popular across Muslim cultures, representing a desirable trait of having a sweet and endearing personality.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Raihaan" is often celebrated in Islamic communities as it carries a beautiful literary and symbolic meaning. It is reminiscent of the rich Arabic language, often valorizing the art of agriculture and its connection to the natural world. This name holds a significant cultural value as it reminds us of the blessings that Allah bestows upon us, and our responsibility to cultivate and protect His creations.
data.spiritual_significance: In terms of spiritual significance, the name "Raihaan" signifies the person who prepares the gardens of Paradise; this metaphorically refers to the individual's endeavor to purify their soul and cultivate good deeds. The name instills a sense of focus and dedication to the greater purpose of striving for personal spiritual growth. The imagery of irrigating and cultivating gardens also represents the idea of sustaining and nurturing that which is valuable, not just in our physical world but also in our spiritual journey towards Allah.
